description: skipInstalls:false makes Renovate run a full `npm install` instead of `npm install --package-lock-only`. npm 12 defaults allow-remote=none, and the lock-only path trips EALLOWREMOTE on registry tarballs of packages that declare bundleDependencies (@tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi here); the full-install path exempts registry tarballs. Revert once npm/cli#9800 is fixed in the npm the Mend runner uses.
